overview_description.description: Confluent offers a streaming platform based on Apache Kafka that enables companies to easily access data as real-time streams. The company's platform offers an open-source technology that acts as a real-time, fault-tolerant and highly scalable messaging system, enabling companies to move data from isolated systems into a real-time data pipeline where they can act on it immediately.

about_short_description.short_description: Confluent offers a streaming platform based on Apache Kafka that enables companies to easily access data as real-time streams.

product.name: Confluent Cloud
product.description: A fully managed, cloud-native data streaming service for running Apache Kafka, connecting data sources, processing streams, and governing data across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

product.name: Confluent Platform
product.description: A self-managed enterprise data streaming platform based on Apache Kafka for deploying streaming infrastructure on premises, in private clouds, or in customer-controlled environments.

product.name: Confluent Data Streaming Platform
product.description: An integrated platform for streaming, connecting, processing, and governing real-time data across applications, data systems, clouds, and on-premises environments.

product.name: Confluent Connectors
product.description: Pre-built and managed integrations that move data between Apache Kafka and databases, SaaS applications, data warehouses, cloud services, and other enterprise systems.

product.name: Confluent Cloud for Apache Flink
product.description: A fully managed, serverless stream processing service for transforming, enriching, analyzing, and acting on real-time data with Apache Flink.

product.name: Stream Governance
product.description: A managed suite for governing streaming data through schema management, data quality controls, cataloging, lineage, discovery, and access-related capabilities.
